text:
Glad it's useful, and yes, it's 2 AM, so definitely time to call it a night.

Before you go, my last response **got cut off** partway through the budget table. These sections are still missing:

- End of the budget table (contingency line and DIY vs. movers totals)
- Room-by-room packing checklist and declutter tips
- Full dog-specific travel checklist (route lodging, car comfort, overnight setup)
- Services and subscriptions cancel/start timeline
- 6–8 week phone-calendar reminder schedule
- Printable one-page moving-day essentials checklist

**Two corrections to what I already gave you:**
- **Emissions testing:** Oregon DEQ testing applies only in the **Portland metro** and **Medford/Ashland** areas, not Klamath Falls.
- **VIN inspection:** Oregon generally requires a **VIN inspection** for vehicles previously titled out of state. It can usually be done at a DMV office when you register, so add it to the post-move DMV visit.

When you're back, just say "finish the checklist," and I'll pick up where it cut off, with the printable one-pager first if you want it soonest. Get some sleep!
